mapper.select: SELECT id, project_code, project_name FROM pm_project WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND project_code=#{projectRef} AND deleted=0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id=ur.tenant_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND ur.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.role_code='SUPER_ADMIN' AND r.status=1 AND r.deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pm_project_member WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status=1 AND deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pm_project WHERE id=#{projectId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pm_project p WHERE p.id=#{projectId} AND p.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND p.deleted=0 AND (p.owner_id=#{userId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pm_project_member m JOIN pm_project_member_role mr ON mr.member_id=m.id AND mr.tenant_id=m.tenant_id JOIN pm_project_role r ON r.id=mr.role_id AND r.tenant_id=mr.tenant_id WHERE m.project_id=p.id AND m.user_id=#{userId} AND m.status=1 AND m.deleted=0 AND r.project_id=p.id AND r.role_code='PM' AND r.deleted=0))

SELECT m.id, m.user_id, u.display_name, u.username FROM pm_project_member m JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=m.user_id AND u.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND u.deleted=0 AND u.status=1 WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND m.project_id=#{projectId} AND m.status=1 AND m.deleted=0 ORDER BY u.display_name,m.id

SELECT m.id, m.user_id, u.display_name, u.username FROM pm_project_member m JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=m.user_id AND u.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND u.deleted=0 AND u.status=1 WHERE m.id=#{memberId} AND m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND m.project_id=#{projectId} AND m.status=1 AND m.deleted=0
mapper.sql: WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0 AND status=1 AND (username LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '\\' OR display_name LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '\\' OR mobile_phone LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '\\')
mapper.select: SELECT id,display_name,username,mobile_phone,status FROM sys_user ORDER BY display_name,id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id,display_name,username,mobile_phone,status FROM sys_user WHERE id=#{userId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0 AND status=1

SELECT c.config_key,c.config_value FROM sys_dict_type t JOIN sys_config c ON c.category_id=t.id AND c.tenant_id=t.tenant_id WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND t.dict_code=#{categoryCode} AND t.status=1 AND t.deleted=0 AND c.status=1 AND c.deleted=0 ORDER BY c.id
SELECT id FROM pm_project WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY id
SELECT project_id FROM pm_project_member WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status=1 AND deleted=0 ORDER BY project_id

SELECT u.id,u.username,u.display_name FROM pm_project_member m JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=m.user_id AND u.tenant_id=m.tenant_id WHERE m.project_id=#{projectId} AND m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND m.status=1 AND m.deleted=0 AND u.status=1 AND u.deleted=0 ORDER BY u.display_name,u.id
SELECT id,role_code,role_name FROM pm_project_role WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY role_name,id
SELECT user_id FROM pm_project_member WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND status=1 AND deleted=0 AND user_id IN #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pm_project_role WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0 AND id IN #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT u.id,u.username,u.display_name FROM pm_project_member_role mr JOIN pm_project_role r ON r.id=mr.role_id AND r.tenant_id=mr.tenant_id AND r.deleted=0 JOIN pm_project_member m ON m.id=mr.member_id AND m.tenant_id=mr.tenant_id AND m.project_id=r.project_id AND m.status=1 AND m.deleted=0 JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=m.user_id AND u.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND u.status=1 AND u.deleted=0 WHERE r.project_id=#{projectId} AND r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.id IN #{id} ORDER BY u.display_name,u.id
